sources.title: GitHub - kohya-ss/ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite
sources.snippet: ComfyUI custom node for ControlNet-LLLite for Anima (DiT-based). LLLite is a lightweight ControlNet variant that injects a low-rank correction into the attention (and optionally MLP) projections of the DiT. This node loads weights trained with kohya-ss/sd-scripts and applies them to the ComfyUI Anima model at inference time. This is intended as a minimal reference implementation. Community ...
